metadata.growth_reference: only rewards from gained formal attribute points; settled before measurement
metadata.baseline: stable mood; no fatigue; top 3 actual-roll-mean dice; energy not limiting

policies.random: uniform card slot and player-selectable targets
policies.greedy: exact one-step expected top-three sum; first listed choice on ties

exclusions: fog (not used by current growth UI)
corrections: capped faces excluded from all increase targets
replacement values revealed per target die type
low replacement band starts at ceil(0.1 * sides)
caveats: formal attribute alone does not determine a full-campaign dice pool
metadata.integer_target: largest T such that P(total >= T) >= requested probability
metadata.uncertainty: PMF exact conditional on each pool; MC SE across independent growth trajectories
